title: Patient Hardship Discount Program Terms: End of a Determination, Renewal and Hardship Payment Plans
content:
**Expiry.** An approved Patient Hardship Discount Program determination expires on the day after its expiry date; the case then shows the status *expired*, closed on that day. Charges with later visit dates are not discounted unless a renewal is approved.

**Renewal.** A renewal application may be made from the level's renewal window — a number of calendar days before expiry. Where the level provides a simplified renewal, the renewal needs only a current benefits letter.

**Hardship payment plans.** A Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan already set up stays in force after the determination expires, but a new hardship payment plan needs an unexpired determination at a level that qualifies the patient for the Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan.

### What these terms mean in practice (hypothetical dates)

A determination has an expiry date of 2026-09-15.

| Item | Position |
|---|---|
| The determination expires | 2026-09-16, the day after the expiry date |
| A charge with a visit date of 2026-09-15 | Within the determination |
| A charge with a visit date of 2026-09-16 | Not discounted unless a renewal is approved |
| A Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan set up before 2026-09-16 | Stays in force after expiry |
| A new hardship payment plan requested on 2026-09-20 | Needs an unexpired determination at a qualifying level; this determination has expired |

### Questions on these terms

- *What does a renewal at a level with a simplified renewal require?* Only a current benefits letter.
- *Does expiry end an existing Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan?* No; it stays in force.
